limitations: Does not classify entire singular locus, conductor, local analytic types, positive-characteristic behavior, projective normality, or embeddings of other coordinate lines. The nonnormality claim is generic along the stated rational curve only. Earlier unindexed general treatments could affect priority.
scientific_integrity: The stated theorem is established by an explicit divisorial valuation argument over characteristic zero. The first m=3 case is already covered by prior special-case records and is included only to express the uniform formula; originality is assessed for all m>=4. Finite computational tests corroborate selected instances and are not substitutes for the proof.
title: A uniform normalization theorem for diminished-Fermat companion surfaces
